Global Styles Import Chain **Sketchpad import chain:** ``` sketchpad/index.tsx ↓ imports sketchpad/globals.css ↓ imports compose/ui/globals.css ↓ imports elements/ui/globals.css (master stylesheet) ↓ imports - tailwindcss (full framework) - elements/ui/theme.css (design tokens) - golden-layout CSS (dark theme) ``` **Sites/Play import chain:** ``` sites/play/index.tsx ↓ imports sites/play/globals.css ↓ imports - elements/ui/globals.css (master stylesheet) - @xyflow/react/dist/style.css - @source directives (elements/ui, sketchpad, js) ``` **Key Difference:** Sites/Play imports elements/ui globals directly AND includes @source directives for Tailwind content scanning, while Sketchpad goes through the compose/ui bundle wrapper. --- ### 4. Entry Points Comparison #### **Sketchpad** (`/workspaces/semio/compose/sketchpad/index.tsx`) ```typescript // Imports import "./globals.css"; import { Sketchpad, ... } from "./index"; import { appRegistry } from "./Sketchpad"; // App registration appRegistry.register(designConfig); appRegistry.register(docsConfig); // ... etc // Rendering createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(
); ``` Key features: - Registers 7 app configs (design, docs, feedback, home, kit, quality, type) - Handles VS Code webview detection and file I/O bridging - Supports optional IndexedDB persistence and temporary kit stores - Wraps Sketchpad in full-screen div with Tailwind utilities #### **Sites/Play** (`/workspaces/semio/compose/sites/play/index.tsx`) ```typescript // Imports import { Sketchpad, appRegistry, ... } from "@semio-tech/compose-sketchpad"; import "./globals.css"; // App registration (same 7 configs) appRegistry.register(...); // Rendering createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(
); ``` Key features: - Imports Sketchpad and configs from @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad bundle - Always uses IndexedDB persistence (no VS Code logic) - Pre-loads a kit file (`/metabolism.zip`) - Similar full-screen layout --- ### 5. Theme Configuration Details **Master Theme Source:** `/workspaces/semio/elements/ui/theme.css` Contains: - **Fonts**: Anta (sans), Kelly Slab (serif), Share Tech Mono (mono), Noto Emoji families - **Colors**: - Brand: primary (#ff344f), secondary (#34d1bf), tertiary (#fa9500) - Status: danger, warning, info, success - Grayscale: 30+ gray shades from dark to light - **Layout**: `--spacing-compact`, `--spacing-touch` - **Typography**: Default and invert prose styles with typography plugin **Tailwind Extensions:** - Typography plugin with custom CSS variable mappings - Dark mode: "media" (system preference) - Content paths: `./**/*.{ts,tsx,mdx}` (app-level configuration) --- ### 6. CSS Variables in Compose Context **Sketchpad-specific additions** (`compose/ui/globals.css`): ```css :root { --color-new: var(--success-border); /* For added entities */ --color-modified: var(--warning-border); /* For modified entities */ --color-removed: var(--destructive-border); /* For removed entities */ --color-changed-selected: var(--accent); --color-changed-hovered: var(--accent-secondary); } ``` These are used by the Diagram component in `compose/ui/index.tsx` for visualizing design diffs. --- ### 7. Configuration Files Relationship ``` Root Tailwind Preset: elements/ui/tailwind.config.ts ↑ ↑ └─ Imported by ─────────────┴─ @compose/ui/tailwind.config.ts (re-export) ↑ └─ Used by compose/sketchpad/tailwind.config.ts ``` **Sites/Play** skips the compose/ui wrapper and imports directly: ``` elements/ui/tailwind.config.ts ↑ └─ Used by sites/play/tailwind.config.ts ``` --- ### 8. PostCSS Pipeline (Both Apps) ```typescript // Both use identical PostCSS config { plugins: { "@tailwindcss/postcss": {} } } ``` This feeds into Vite's @tailwindcss/vite plugin which: 1. Processes Tailwind CSS from `tailwindcss` import 2. Applies PostCSS plugins (including tailwind's @layer directives) 3. Scans content paths for class names 4. Generates optimized CSS bundles --- ### 9. Vite Build Configuration Both apps configure identical Vite setups: - **Tailwind plugin**: Dynamic async import of @tailwindcss/vite - **MDX plugin**: Pre-enforce with Remark plugins (GFM, frontmatter) and Rehype plugins (slug, autolink headings) - **React plugin**: @vitejs/plugin-react v5.1.2 - **WASM support**: vite-plugin-wasm + vite-plugin-top-level-await - **Custom middleware**: Serves .wasm files and /assets/* directory - **Optimization**: excludes compose packages from dependency optimization - **SSR**: "noExternal" for golden-layout --- ### 10.
